When one delivery slot is released, execute only request 4719e525-763b-42a4-9f16-e71e1c38b17b. Smallest reversible prototype: refine CTA hierarchy, adjacent disclosure placement, keyboard focus, contrast, tap targets, and responsive layout on existing affiliate/product surfaces while preserving destinations, tracking IDs, consent, dependencies, and cross-site isolation. Acceptance: deterministic tests, accessibility audit, build, link validation, smoke test, and visual review. Measure registered affiliate clicks for 14 days or 100 new relevant impressions/clicks, whichever comes first. Roll back the isolated diff on validation, destination, disclosure, consent, or responsive regressions.

Defer new prototypes until capacity and measurement gates clear. The strongest reusable opportunities are a consent-preserving CTA component pattern and a disposable SEO-content extraction prototype using MarkItDown or Mermaid, but current lab evidence only establishes plausible fit: MarkItDown and Mermaid are MIT-licensed, while maintenance, dependency, security, and fleet-specific performance remain unvalidated because dependencies were not installed. Time-to-learn should be measured in an isolated prototype before any adoption decision; no deployment, spend, credential change, dependency addition, or domain change is authorized.
